signal: Empact Technologies launched NexusIQ, an AI-native compliance platform, and signed multi-year deals with Sabanci Renewables and Maas Energy Works.

email.body1:
Trish, saw Empact launched NexusIQ and locked in multi-year deals with Sabanci Renewables and Maas Energy Works.

New platform plus marquee wins usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Empact off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Trish, quick follow-up for Empact.

As compliance demand from the new tax-credit rules grows, the number of accounts worth working tends to outrun the team faster than expected. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Empact needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Trish, last bit of proof for Empact.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Empact's reply rate likely compares to peer compliance-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Trish, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A platform launch and new partnerships make for a busy stretch, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I will tailor it to Empact either way.
